summary: The proposal outlines a detailed schedule with clear modular objectives, but it lacks end‑to‑end integration across iterations and fails to define measurable documentation deliverables. Addressing these schedule and methodology gaps will strengthen the project's feasibility and clarity.

findings.title: Horizontal task decomposition without end‑to‑end features
findings.description: Iterations focus on isolated layers (e.g., modularizing backend, implementing pipeline) rather than delivering vertically integrated, end‑to‑end functionality, which contradicts the schedule quality rule.

locations.quote: •   **Modularize Thesis Management to prepare integration of the feedback module** (Objective 4)

findings.title: Vague and non‑measurable deliverable in final iteration
findings.description: Iteration 9 lists “Documentation” without specifying what documentation, format, or measurable outcome, violating the requirement for measurable deliverables.
